description: This file contains unit tests for the BigUnsigned class in the Abseil library, specifically testing bit shifting, multiplication, and power functions for large big integers.

classes.name: BigUnsigned
classes.description: Template class representing large unsigned integers with arbitrary precision, supporting operations like shifting and multiplication.

methods.name: ShiftLeft
methods.description: Shifts the big integer left by a specified number of bits, with handling for overflow and bounds.

methods.name: MultiplyBy
methods.description: Multiplies the big integer by a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: MultiplyByFiveToTheNth
methods.description: Multiplies the big integer by 5 raised to the power n.

methods.name: MultiplyByTenToTheNth
methods.description: Multiplies the big integer by 10 raised to the power n.

methods.name: FiveToTheNth
methods.description: Static method returning 5 raised to the power n as a BigUnsigned.
